```
   139→    synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))
   140→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   141→    new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids
   142→    resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids
   143→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   144→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   145→
   146→    return SynthesisInput(
   147→        open_findings=open_review,
   148→        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   149→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   150→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   151→        new_since_last=new_since,
   152→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   153→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   154→        synthesis_version=version,
   155→    )
   156→
   157→
   158→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   159→# Prompt construction
   160→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   161→
   162→_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   163→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   164→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   165→
   166→Your plan should:
   167→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   168→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   169→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   170→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   171→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   172→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   173→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   174→
   175→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   176→
   177→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   178→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   179→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   180→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   181→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   182→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   183→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   184→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   185→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   186→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   187→
   188→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   189→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   190→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   191→
   192→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   193→{
   194→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   195→  "epics": [
   196→    {
   197→      "name": "slug-name",
   198→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   199→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   200→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   201→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   202→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   203→      "agent_safe": true,
   204→      "dependency_order": 1,
   205→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   206→      "status": "pending"
   207→    }
   208→  ],
   209→  "dismissed_findings": [
   210→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   211→  ],
   212→  "contradiction_notes": [
   213→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   214→  ],
   215→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   216→}
   217→"""
   218→
   219→
   220→def build_synthesis_prompt(si: SynthesisInput) -> str:
   221→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   222→    parts: list[str] = []
   223→
   224→    # Section: existing epics
   225→    if si.existing_epics:
   226→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   227→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   228→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   229→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   230→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   231→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   232→            parts.append(
   233→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   234→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   235→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   236→            )
   237→        parts.append("")
   238→
   239→    # Section: what changed
   240→    if si.new_since_last:
   241→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   242→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   243→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   244→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   245→        parts.append("")
   246→
   247→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   248→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   249→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   250→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   251→        parts.append("")
   252→
   253→    # Section: all open review findings
   254→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   255→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   256→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   257→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   258→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   259→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   260→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   261→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   262→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   263→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   264→        if dimension:
   265→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   266→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   267→        if suggestion:
   268→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   269→    parts.append("")
   270→
   271→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   272→    if si.dimension_scores:
   273→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   274→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   275→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   276→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   277→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   278→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   279→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   280→        parts.append("")
   281→
   282→    # Section: previously dismissed
   283→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   284→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   285→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   286→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   287→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   288→        parts.append("")
   289→
   290→    return "\n".join(parts)
   291→
```

```
    99→class PlanModel(TypedDict, total=False):
   100→    version: Required[int]
   101→    created: Required[str]
   102→    updated: Required[str]
   103→    queue_order: list[str]
   104→    deferred: list[str]  # kept empty for migration compat
   105→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry]
   106→    active_cluster: str | None
   107→    overrides: dict[str, ItemOverride]
   108→    clusters: dict[str, Cluster]
   109→    superseded: dict[str, SupersededEntry]
   110→    epic_synthesis_meta: EpicSynthesisMeta
   111→    deleted_clusters: list[str]  # cluster_keys of deleted auto-clusters
   112→
   113→
   114→def empty_plan() -> PlanModel:
   115→    """Return a new empty plan payload."""
   116→    now = utc_now()
   117→    return {
   118→        "version": PLAN_VERSION,
   119→        "created": now,
   120→        "updated": now,
   121→        "queue_order": [],
   122→        "deferred": [],
   123→        "skipped": {},
   124→        "active_cluster": None,
   125→        "overrides": {},
   126→        "clusters": {},
   127→        "superseded": {},
   128→        "epic_synthesis_meta": {},
   129→        "deleted_clusters": [],
   130→    }
   131→
   132→
   133→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   134→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   135→
   136→    Handles migrations:
   137→    - v1 → v2: deferred list → skipped dict
   138→    - v3 → v4: epics dict → synthesis-clusters in clusters dict
   139→    """
   140→    defaults = empty_plan()
   141→    for key, value in defaults.items():
   142→        plan.setdefault(key, value)
   143→
   144→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   145→        plan["queue_order"] = []
   146→    if not isinstance(plan.get("deferred"), list):
   147→        plan["deferred"] = []
   148→    if not isinstance(plan.get("skipped"), dict):
   149→        plan["skipped"] = {}
   150→    if not isinstance(plan.get("overrides"), dict):
   151→        plan["overrides"] = {}
   152→    if not isinstance(plan.get("clusters"), dict):
   153→        plan["clusters"] = {}
   154→    if not isinstance(plan.get("superseded"), dict):
   155→        plan["superseded"] = {}
   156→    if not isinstance(plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta"), dict):
   157→        plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {}
   158→    meta = plan["epic_synthesis_meta"]
   159→    if not isinstance(meta.get("synthesis_stages"), dict):
   160→        meta["synthesis_stages"] = {}
   161→    if not isinstance(plan.get("deleted_clusters"), list):
   162→        plan["deleted_clusters"] = []
   163→
   164→    # Migrate deferred → skipped (v1 → v2)
   165→    deferred: list[str] = plan["deferred"]
   166→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   167→    if deferred:
   168→        now = utc_now()
   169→        for fid in list(deferred):
   170→            if fid not in skipped:
   171→                skipped[fid] = {
   172→                    "finding_id": fid,
   173→                    "kind": "temporary",
   174→                    "reason": None,
   175→                    "note": None,
   176→                    "attestation": None,
   177→                    "created_at": now,
   178→                    "review_after": None,
   179→                    "skipped_at_scan": 0,
   180→                }
   181→        deferred.clear()
   182→
   183→    # Normalize cluster fields
   184→    for cluster in plan["clusters"].values():
   185→        if isinstance(cluster, dict):
   186→            if not isinstance(cluster.get("finding_ids"), list):
   187→                cluster["finding_ids"] = []
   188→            cluster.setdefault("auto", False)
   189→            cluster.setdefault("cluster_key", "")
   190→            cluster.setdefault("action", None)
   191→            cluster.setdefault("user_modified", False)
   192→
   193→    # Migrate epics → clusters (v3 → v4)
   194→    old_epics = plan.pop("epics", None)
   195→    if old_epics and isinstance(old_epics, dict):
   196→        clusters = plan["clusters"]
   197→        now = utc_now()
   198→        for name, epic in old_epics.items():
   199→            if name not in clusters:
   200→                clusters[name] = {
   201→                    "name": name,
   202→                    "description": epic.get("thesis"),
   203→                    "finding_ids": list(epic.get("finding_ids", [])),
   204→                    "auto": True,
   205→                    "cluster_key": f"epic::{name}",
   206→                    "action": f"desloppify plan focus {name}",
   207→                    "user_modified": False,
   208→                    "created_at": epic.get("created_at", now),
   209→                    "updated_at": epic.get("updated_at", now),
   210→                    "thesis": epic.get("thesis"),
   211→                    "direction": epic.get("direction"),
   212→                    "root_cause": epic.get("root_cause"),
   213→                    "agent_safe": epic.get("agent_safe", False),
   214→                    "dependency_order": epic.get("dependency_order", 999),
   215→                    "action_steps": epic.get("action_steps", []),
   216→                    "status": epic.get("status", "pending"),
   217→                    "synthesis_version": epic.get("synthesis_version", 0),
   218→                    "supersedes": epic.get("supersedes", []),
   219→                    "dismissed": epic.get("dismissed", []),
   220→                    "source_clusters": epic.get("source_clusters", []),
   221→                }
   222→
   223→
   224→def synthesis_clusters(plan: PlanModel) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   225→    """Return clusters that were created by epic synthesis (have a thesis)."""
   226→    return {
   227→        name: cluster
   228→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   229→        if cluster.get("thesis")
   230→    }
   231→
   232→
   233→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   234→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   235→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   236→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   237→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   238→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   239→
   240→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   241→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   242→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   243→    if overlap:
   244→        raise ValueError(
   245→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   246→        )
   247→
   248→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   249→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   250→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   251→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   252→            raise ValueError(
   253→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
```

```
    56→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:

    58→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify

   100→
   101→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   102→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   103→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   104→
   105→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   106→    plan: PlanModel,
   107→    state: StateModel,
   108→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   109→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   110→
   111→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   112→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   113→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   114→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   115→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   116→    """
   117→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   118→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   119→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   120→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   121→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   122→
   123→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   124→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   125→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   126→        fid for fid in order
   127→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   128→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   129→        and fid not in stale_ids
   130→    ]
   131→    for fid in to_remove:
   132→        order.remove(fid)
   133→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   134→
   135→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs to front ----------------------------
   136→    existing = set(order)
   137→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   138→        if uid not in existing:
   139→            order.insert(0, uid)
   140→            result.injected.append(uid)
   141→
   142→    return result
   143→
   144→
   145→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   146→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   147→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   148→
   149→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   150→    plan: PlanModel,
   151→    state: StateModel,
   152→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   153→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale subjective dimensions.
   154→
   155→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   156→       longer stale and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned by
   157→       ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   158→    2. If no objective items remain after cleanup, inject all currently-stale
   159→       dimension IDs so the plan surfaces them as actionable work.
   160→    """
   161→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   162→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   163→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   164→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   165→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   166→
   167→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   168→    # Only prune IDs that are neither stale nor unscored.
   169→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   170→        fid for fid in order
   171→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   172→        and fid not in stale_ids
   173→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   174→    ]
   175→    for fid in to_remove:
   176→        order.remove(fid)
   177→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   178→
   179→    # --- Inject: populate when no objective items remain -----------------
   180→    has_real_items = any(fid for fid in order if not fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX))
   181→    if not has_real_items and stale_ids:
   182→        existing = set(order)
   183→        for sid in sorted(stale_ids):
   184→            if sid not in existing:
   185→                order.append(sid)
   186→                result.injected.append(sid)
   187→
   188→    return result
   189→
   190→
   191→@dataclass
   192→class SynthesisSyncResult:
   193→    """What changed during a synthesis sync."""
   194→
   195→    injected: bool = False
   196→    pruned: bool = False
   197→
   198→    @property
   199→    def changes(self) -> int:
   200→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
```

## Comprehensive Report: Resolved/Completed Finding Tracking in Synthesis Workflow

Based on my thorough analysis of the codebase, here's the complete picture of how previously resolved/completed findings are tracked and surfaced during the synthesis workflow:

---

### 1. **SynthesisInput Data Structure** (`epic_synthesis.py`)

The `SynthesisInput` dataclass (lines 62-73) collects critical history data:

```python
@dataclass
class SynthesisInput:
    open_findings: dict[str, dict]              # Only OPEN review/concerns findings
    mechanical_findings: dict[str, dict]        # Non-review findings for context
    existing_epics: dict[str, Cluster]          # Current synthesis clusters
    dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]
    new_since_last: set[str]                    # Finding IDs NEW since last synthesis
    resolved_since_last: set[str]               # **KEY: Finding IDs RESOLVED since last**
    previously_dismissed: list[str]             # IDs dismissed in prior synthesis
    synthesis_version: int
```

**Critical finding**: `resolved_since_last` (line 71) explicitly tracks findings that were in the synthesis snapshot but are no longer open.

---

### 2. **How `resolved_since_last` is Computed** (`epic_synthesis.py:122-155`)

In `collect_synthesis_input()`:

```python
synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))          # IDs from last synthesis
current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())                    # Currently open review findings
new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids                 # New findings
resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids            # **RESOLVED ones**
previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))      # Kept dismissed list
```

**Line 142**: `resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids` — any ID that WAS synthesized but is NO LONGER in the open findings list is marked as resolved.

---

### 3. **EpicSynthesisMeta** (`schema.py:76-84`)

The synthesis metadata tracks history in `plan["epic_synthesis_meta"]`:

```python
class EpicSynthesisMeta(TypedDict, total=False):
    synthesized_ids: list[str]                  # All open review IDs included in last synthesis
    last_run: str                               # ISO timestamp
    version: int                                # Incrementing version number
    dismissed_ids: list[str]                    # IDs explicitly dismissed by LLM
    finding_snapshot_hash: str                  # MD5 hash of open review IDs (for change detection)
    strategy_summary: str                       # Human-readable meta-plan narrative
    trigger: str                                # Why synthesis ran ("new findings imported", "findings resolved", etc.)
    synthesis_stages: dict[str, SynthesisStageReport]  # Detailed stage progress
```

**Key point**: `synthesized_ids` is the baseline against which resolved findings are detected. After each synthesis run, it's updated to the current set of open review IDs (line 523 in `epic_synthesis.py`).

---

### 4. **Synthesis Prompt Includes Resolved Findings** (`epic_synthesis.py:220-290`)

The LLM receives explicit notification of resolved findings in `build_synthesis_prompt()`:

```python
# Lines 247-251:
if si.resolved_since_last:
    parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
    for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
        parts.append(f"- {fid}")
    parts.append("")
```

**Impact**: The LLM is explicitly told which findings have been resolved and can:
- Remove them from existing epics
- Mark epics as completed if all findings are resolved
- Adjust the meta-plan accordingly

---

### 5. **Superseded Entries** (`schema.py:87-97`, `reconcile.py`)

When findings disappear from the state (resolved, removed, etc.), they're tracked separately in `plan["superseded"]`:

```python
class SupersededEntry(TypedDict, total=False):
    original_id: Required[str]                  # The finding ID that disappeared
    original_detector: str                      # Detector type (e.g., "review")
    original_file: str                          # File path
    original_summary: str                       # Last known summary
    status: str                                 # "superseded" | "remapped" | "dismissed"
    superseded_at: str                          # ISO timestamp
    remapped_to: str | None                     # If matched to a new finding
    candidates: list[str]                       # Potential matches (up to 5)
    note: str | None                            # Preserved from overrides
```

**Lifecycle** (`reconcile.py:47-96`):
1. During `reconcile_plan_after_scan()`, any plan-referenced ID that's no longer alive in state is moved to superseded
2. Finding context (detector, file, summary) is preserved for audit trail
3. Superseded entries older than 90 days (SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS) are pruned

---

### 6. **Synthesis Reconciliation** (`reconcile.py:124-200`)

Post-scan reconciliation handles resolved findings:

```python
# Lines 179-198: Synthesis-cluster cleanup
dead_ids = {fid for fid in result.superseded}
for cname in list(clusters.keys()):
    cluster = clusters[cname]
    if not cluster.get("thesis"):
        continue  # Only synthesis-clusters
    fids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
    alive = [fid for fid in fids if fid not in dead_ids]
    if len(alive) != len(fids):
        cluster["finding_ids"] = alive           # Remove dead findings
        cluster["updated_at"] = now
    # **Mark completed if all findings resolved**
    if not alive and cluster.get("status") != "completed":
        cluster["status"] = "completed"
        cluster["updated_at"] = now
    # **Delete empty synthesis-clusters**
    if not alive:
        del clusters[cname]
```

**Key behavior**: When a synthesis cluster's all findings are resolved, it's automatically marked `completed` and then deleted.

---

### 7. **Synthesis Sync Trigger** (`stale_dimensions.py:216-269`)

The synthesis sync decides when re-synthesis is needed:

```python
def sync_synthesis_needed(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> SynthesisSyncResult:
    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)  # Hash of open review IDs
    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
    
    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
        # Need synthesis — IDs have changed (new or resolved)
        if not has_synthesis:
            order.insert(insert_pos, SYNTHESIS_ID)  # Queue synthesis::pending
        # Reset stages on landscape change (unless observe was very recent)
```

**Trigger**: Anytime the set of open review findings changes (new OR resolved), synthesis::pending is injected into the queue and prior synthesis stages are reset.

`build_synthesis_item()` exposes resolved finding metrics to the queue:

```python
    "kind": "synthesis_needed",

        "total_review_findings": total,
        "new_since_last": new_since_last,

        "pending_epics": pending_epics,

}
```


**Visibility**: The count and trigger ("findings resolved") are surfaced to users viewing the synthesis::pending item.

### 9. **Finding Status States** (`engine/_state/schema.py`, `resolution.py`)

At the state layer, findings have explicit resolution statuses:

```python
FindingStatus = Literal["open", "fixed", "auto_resolved", "wontfix", "false_positive"]
```

Each finding has:
```python
status: FindingStatus
resolved_at: str | None       # ISO timestamp when resolved
resolution_attestation: dict  # Metadata: kind, text, attested_at, scan_verified
wontfix_snapshot: dict        # Snapshot of tier/confidence when wontfixed
```

**How findings are marked done** (`override_handlers.py:267-309`):
- `cmd_plan_done()` → delegates to `cmd_resolve()` with status="fixed"
- `cmd_plan_skip(..., --permanent)` → marks in state as "wontfix"
- `cmd_plan_skip(..., --false-positive)` → marks in state as "false_positive"

---

### 10. **Plan Skip Entries** (`schema.py:21-30`)

Findings can be skipped in the plan with explicit metadata:

```python
class SkipEntry(TypedDict, total=False):
    finding_id: Required[str]
    kind: Required[str]                # "temporary" | "permanent" | "false_positive" | "synthesized_out"
    reason: str | None
    note: str | None                   # Required for permanent (wontfix explanation)
    attestation: str | None
    created_at: str
    review_after: int | None           # For temporary: resurface after N scans
    skipped_at_scan: int               # Scan count when skipped
    original_position: int | None      # Queue position before skip
```

**"synthesized_out" kind** (lines 464, 482 in `epic_synthesis.py`): Findings dismissed by the LLM are added to skipped with kind="synthesized_out" and reason from LLM output.

---

### 11. **Dismissed IDs History** (Epic Synthesis)

Three layers of dismissal:

1. **Previously dismissed** (`previously_dismissed` list): IDs dismissed in prior synthesis runs, passed to LLM for context
2. **Per-epic dismissed** (Cluster.dismissed field): Findings explicitly dismissed within an epic
3. **Synthesis-wide dismissed** (skipped with kind="synthesized_out"): Top-level dismissals

**Preservation** (line 526 in `epic_synthesis.py`):
```python
"dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,  # Saved to meta for next synthesis
```

---

### 12. **Complete Resolution Workflow**

```
Finding becomes resolved in state (status != "open")
                    ↓
Next scan runs → reconcile_plan_after_scan()
                    ↓
Superseded entry created for disappeared findings
Synthesis clusters cleaned up; empty ones marked "completed" and deleted
                    ↓
sync_synthesis_needed() detects hash mismatch (resolved IDs removed)
                    ↓
synthesis::pending injected into queue (if review findings still exist)
                    ↓
collect_synthesis_input() computes resolved_since_last
                    ↓
build_synthesis_prompt() includes "Resolved since last synthesis" section
                    ↓
LLM receives context, can:
  - Remove resolved IDs from epics
  - Mark epics complete
  - Suggest next steps
                    ↓
apply_synthesis_to_plan() updates synthesized_ids to current open IDs
Meta updated with new hash, version, trigger="findings resolved"
                    ↓
build_synthesis_item() exposes resolved_since_last count to queue
```

### Summary

Resolved findings are tracked through **multiple complementary mechanisms**:

1. **Snapshot-based detection**: `synthesized_ids` in metadata serves as the baseline; current open review IDs compared against it reveals resolved ones
2. **Hash-based change detection**: `finding_snapshot_hash` (MD5 of open review IDs) triggers re-synthesis when findings resolve
3. **Explicit accounting**: `resolved_since_last` count in SynthesisInput and synthesis item detail
4. **Superseded registry**: Permanent record of disappeared findings in `plan["superseded"]` with 90-day TTL
5. **Cluster lifecycle**: Synthesis clusters auto-marked "completed" and deleted when all findings resolve
6. **LLM visibility**: Resolved findings explicitly listed in synthesis prompt so LLM can adapt meta-plan
7. **State-layer resolution**: Finding status set to "fixed"/"wontfix"/"false_positive" with timestamps and attestation
8. **Dismissed history**: Previously dismissed IDs retained for continuity across synthesis runs

The system is designed to **preserve history while driving forward progress**, ensuring the synthesis engine always knows what was accomplished and can adjust the meta-plan accordingly.

### 1. **Review Finding Schema & Import** (`desloppify/intelligence/review/importing/`)

- `reasoning` - Optional explanation

### 6. **Resolving Review Findings** (`resolve/cmd.py` + `resolution.py`)

When `desloppify resolve` marks a review finding as complete:

```python
# In resolve_findings() state-layer operation:
updates = {
  "status": "fixed|wontfix|false_positive",
  "resolved_at": "ISO timestamp",
  "note": str | None,
  "resolution_attestation": {
    "kind": "manual",
    "text": attestation_text,
    "attested_at": "ISO timestamp",
    "scan_verified": False  # Until next scan verifies
  },
  "suppressed": False,
  "suppression_pattern": None
}

# Special handling for review findings:
if finding.get("detector") == "review":
  # Mark dimension assessment as stale
  state["subjective_assessments"][dimension].update({
    "needs_review_refresh": True,
    "refresh_reason": f"review_finding_{status}",  # e.g., "review_finding_fixed"
    "stale_since": now
  })

# Plan-layer cleanup:
if has_living_plan:
  purge_ids(plan, [resolved_id])  # Remove from queue, skipped, clusters
  
  # Track epic progress:
  for epic in synthesis_clusters(plan):
    if resolved_id in epic.get("finding_ids", []):
      epic["finding_ids"].remove(resolved_id)
      if not epic["finding_ids"]:
        epic["status"] = "completed"
```

**Attestation Requirements**:
- `--attest "reason text"` captures human justification
- Stored in `resolution_attestation` dict
- Not scan-verified until next scan confirms absence

When review findings are re-imported and missing from new payload:

```python
def _auto_resolve_stale_holistic():
  # For findings not in latest import:
  for finding in open_holistic_findings:
    if finding not in new_import:
      # If full_sweep_included OR dimension was in scope:
      resolve_findings(state, finding_id, status="auto_resolved", 
                      note="not reported in latest holistic re-import")
      
  # Track in diff:
  diff["auto_resolved"] += count
```

### 10. **Key Data Fields Summary**

| Layer | Structure | Key Fields |
|-------|-----------|-----------|
| **Finding** (state.json) | TypedDict | id, detector, summary, detail (dimension/evidence/suggestion), status, resolution_attestation |
| **Assessment** (state.json) | dict | score, source, assessed_at, needs_review_refresh |
| **Cluster** (plan.json) | Cluster dict | name, finding_ids, thesis, status, dependency_order, dismissed |
| **SynthesisMeta** (plan.json) | dict | synthesized_ids, dismissed_ids, strategy_summary, synthesis_stages |
| **Skip Entry** (plan.json) | SkipEntry dict | finding_id, kind, reason, attestation, review_after |

---

This architecture ensures:
1. **Traceability** - Each finding has ID, timestamps, and resolution history
2. **Auditability** - Attestations capture why decisions were made
3. **Incrementality** - Synthesis updates existing clusters rather than rebuilding
4. **Staleness tracking** - Assessment scores marked needing refresh when findings change
5. **Plan persistence** - Manual synthesis stages recorded for incomplete work
6. **Epic scope** - Dismissed findings tracked to avoid re-synthesis churn

```
   137→            open_mechanical[fid] = f
   138→
   139→    synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))
   140→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   141→    new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids
   142→    resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids
   143→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   144→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   145→
   146→    return SynthesisInput(
   147→        open_findings=open_review,
   148→        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   149→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   150→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   151→        new_since_last=new_since,
   152→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   153→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   154→        synthesis_version=version,
   155→    )
   156→
   157→
   158→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   159→# Prompt construction
   160→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   161→
   162→_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   163→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   164→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   165→
   166→Your plan should:
   167→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   168→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   169→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   170→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   171→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   172→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   173→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   174→
   175→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   176→
   177→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   178→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   179→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   180→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   181→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   182→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   183→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   184→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   185→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   186→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   187→
   188→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   189→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   190→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   191→
   192→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   193→{
   194→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   195→  "epics": [
   196→    {
   197→      "name": "slug-name",
   198→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   199→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   200→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   201→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   202→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   203→      "agent_safe": true,
   204→      "dependency_order": 1,
   205→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   206→      "status": "pending"
   207→    }
   208→  ],
   209→  "dismissed_findings": [
   210→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   211→  ],
   212→  "contradiction_notes": [
   213→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   214→  ],
   215→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   216→}
   217→"""
   218→
   219→
   220→def build_synthesis_prompt(si: SynthesisInput) -> str:
   221→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   222→    parts: list[str] = []
   223→
   224→    # Section: existing epics
   225→    if si.existing_epics:
   226→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   227→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   228→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   229→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   230→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   231→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   232→            parts.append(
   233→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   234→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   235→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   236→            )
   237→        parts.append("")
   238→
   239→    # Section: what changed
   240→    if si.new_since_last:
   241→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   242→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   243→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   244→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   245→        parts.append("")
   246→
   247→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   248→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   249→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   250→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   251→        parts.append("")
   252→
   253→    # Section: all open review findings
   254→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   255→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   256→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   257→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   258→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   259→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   260→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   261→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   262→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   263→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   264→        if dimension:
   265→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   266→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   267→        if suggestion:
   268→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   269→    parts.append("")
   270→
   271→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   272→    if si.dimension_scores:
   273→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   274→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   275→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   276→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   277→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   278→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   279→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   280→        parts.append("")
   281→
   282→    # Section: previously dismissed
   283→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   284→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   285→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   286→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   287→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   288→        parts.append("")
   289→
   290→    return "\n".join(parts)
   291→
   292→
   293→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   294→# Result parsing
   295→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   296→
   297→def parse_synthesis_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> SynthesisResult:
   298→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a SynthesisResult.
   299→
   300→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   301→    """
   302→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   303→
   304→    epics: list[dict] = []
   305→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   306→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   307→            continue
   308→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   309→        if not name:
   310→            continue
   311→        # Validate direction
   312→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   313→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   314→            direction = "simplify"
   315→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   316→        finding_ids = [
   317→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   318→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   319→        ]
   320→        dismissed = [
   321→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   322→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   323→        ]
   324→        action_steps = [
   325→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   326→            if isinstance(s, str)
   327→        ]
   328→
   329→        epics.append({
   330→            "name": name,
   331→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   332→            "direction": direction,
   333→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   334→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   335→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   336→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   337→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   338→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   339→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   340→        })
   341→
   342→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   343→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   344→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   345→            continue
   346→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   347→        if fid in valid_ids:
   348→            dismissed_findings.append(
   349→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   350→            )
   351→
   352→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   353→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   354→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   355→            continue
   356→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   357→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   358→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   359→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   360→        ))
   361→
   362→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   363→
   364→    return SynthesisResult(
   365→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   366→        epics=epics,
   367→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   368→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   369→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   370→    )
   371→
   372→
   373→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   374→# Plan mutation
   375→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   376→
   377→def apply_synthesis_to_plan(
   378→    plan: PlanModel,
   379→    state: StateModel,
   380→    synthesis: SynthesisResult,
   381→    *,
   382→    trigger: str = "manual",
   383→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   384→    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
   385→
   386→    1. Creates/updates synthesis-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   387→    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
   388→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   389→    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
   390→    """
   391→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   392→    now = utc_now()
   393→    result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   394→    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
   395→
   396→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   397→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   398→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   399→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   400→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   401→    result.synthesis_version = version
   402→
   403→    # --- Update/create synthesis-clusters ------------------------------------
   404→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   405→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   406→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   407→
   408→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   409→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   410→            # Update existing synthesis-cluster
   411→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   412→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   413→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   414→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   415→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   416→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   417→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   418→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   419→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   420→            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
   421→            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   422→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   423→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   424→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   425→            result.epics_updated += 1
   426→        else:
   427→            # Create new synthesis-cluster
   428→            cluster: Cluster = {
   429→                "name": epic_name,
   430→                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
   431→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   432→                "auto": True,
   433→                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
   434→                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   435→                "user_modified": False,
   436→                "created_at": now,
   437→                "updated_at": now,
   438→                # Epic fields
   439→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   440→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   441→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   442→                "supersedes": [],
   443→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   444→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   445→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   446→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   447→                "source_clusters": [],
   448→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   449→                "synthesis_version": version,
   450→            }
   451→            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
   452→            result.epics_created += 1
   453→
   454→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   455→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   456→    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
   457→        fid = df.finding_id
   458→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   459→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
   460→        if fid in order:
   461→            order.remove(fid)
   462→        skipped[fid] = {
   463→            "finding_id": fid,
   464→            "kind": "synthesized_out",
   465→            "reason": df.reason,
   466→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   467→            "attestation": None,
   468→            "created_at": now,
   469→            "review_after": None,
   470→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   471→        }
   472→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   473→
   474→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   475→    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
   476→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   477→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   478→                order.remove(fid)
   479→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   480→                skipped[fid] = {
   481→                    "finding_id": fid,
   482→                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
   483→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   484→                    "note": None,
   485→                    "attestation": None,
   486→                    "created_at": now,
   487→                    "review_after": None,
   488→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   489→                }
   490→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   491→
   492→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   493→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   494→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   495→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   496→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   497→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   498→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   499→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   500→
   501→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   502→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   503→    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
   504→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import SYNTHESIS_ID
   505→    new_order: list[str] = []
   506→    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
   507→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
   508→        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
   509→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   510→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   511→    order.clear()
   512→    order.extend(new_order)
   513→
   514→    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
   515→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   516→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   517→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   518→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   519→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   520→    )
   521→
   522→    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
   523→        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
   524→        "last_run": now,
   525→        "version": version,
   526→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   527→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   528→        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
   529→        "trigger": trigger,
   530→    }
   531→    plan["updated"] = now
   532→
   533→    return result
   534→
   535→
   536→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   537→# Top-level orchestrator
   538→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   539→
   540→@dataclass
   541→class SynthesisDeps:
   542→    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
   543→
   544→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   545→
   546→
   547→def synthesize_epics(
   548→    plan: PlanModel,
   549→    state: StateModel,
   550→    *,
   551→    deps: SynthesisDeps | None = None,
   552→    dry_run: bool = False,
   553→    trigger: str = "manual",
   554→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   555→    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   556→
   557→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   558→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   559→
   560→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   561→    """
   562→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   563→    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
   564→
   565→    prompt = build_synthesis_prompt(si)
   566→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   567→
   568→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   569→        result = SynthesisMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   570→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   571→        return result
   572→
   573→    # Call LLM
   574→    try:
   575→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   576→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   577→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   578→        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   579→        result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   580→        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
   581→        return result
   582→
   583→    synthesis = parse_synthesis_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   584→    return apply_synthesis_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
   585→
   586→
   587→__all__ = [
   588→    "DismissedFinding",
   589→    "FINDING_ID_RE",
   590→    "SynthesisDeps",
   591→    "SynthesisInput",
   592→    "SynthesisMutationResult",
   593→    "SynthesisResult",
   594→    "apply_synthesis_to_plan",
   595→    "build_synthesis_prompt",
   596→    "collect_synthesis_input",
   597→    "extract_finding_citations",
   598→    "parse_synthesis_result",
   599→    "synthesize_epics",
   600→]
   601→
```

```
   186→def utc_now() -> str:
   187→    """Return current UTC timestamp with second-level precision."""
   188→    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
   189→

   191→def empty_state() -> StateModel:
   192→    """Return a new empty state payload."""
   193→    return {
   194→        "version": CURRENT_VERSION,
   195→        "created": utc_now(),
   196→        "last_scan": None,
   197→        "scan_count": 0,
   198→        "overall_score": 0,
   199→        "objective_score": 0,
   200→        "strict_score": 0,
   201→        "verified_strict_score": 0,
   202→        "stats": {},
   203→        "findings": {},
   204→        "scan_coverage": {},
   205→        "score_confidence": {},
   206→        "subjective_integrity": {},
   207→        "subjective_assessments": {},
   208→    }

   210→
   211→def _as_non_negative_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
   212→    try:
   213→        parsed = int(value)
   214→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   215→        return default
   216→    return parsed if parsed >= 0 else 0
   217→
   218→
   219→def ensure_state_defaults(state: StateModel | dict) -> None:
   220→    """Normalize loose/legacy state payloads to a valid base shape in-place."""
   221→    for key, value in empty_state().items():
   222→        state.setdefault(key, value)
   223→
   224→    if not isinstance(state.get("findings"), dict):
   225→        state["findings"] = {}
   226→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   227→        state["stats"] = {}
   228→    if not isinstance(state.get("scan_history"), list):
   229→        state["scan_history"] = []
   230→    if not isinstance(state.get("scan_coverage"), dict):
   231→        state["scan_coverage"] = {}
   232→    if not isinstance(state.get("score_confidence"), dict):
   233→        state["score_confidence"] = {}
   234→    if not isinstance(state.get("subjective_integrity"), dict):
   235→        state["subjective_integrity"] = {}
   236→
   237→    findings = state["findings"]
   238→    to_remove: list[str] = []
   239→    for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
   240→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   241→            to_remove.append(finding_id)
   242→            continue
   243→
   244→        finding.setdefault("id", finding_id)
   245→        finding.setdefault("detector", "unknown")
   246→        finding.setdefault("file", "")
   247→        finding.setdefault("tier", 3)
   248→        finding.setdefault("confidence", "low")
   249→        finding.setdefault("summary", "")
   250→        finding.setdefault("detail", {})
   251→        finding.setdefault("status", "open")
   252→        finding["status"] = canonical_finding_status(
   253→            finding.get("status"),
   254→            default="open",
   255→        )
   256→        finding.setdefault("note", None)
   257→        finding.setdefault("first_seen", state.get("created") or utc_now())
   258→        finding.setdefault("last_seen", finding["first_seen"])
   259→        finding.setdefault("resolved_at", None)
   260→        finding["reopen_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(
   261→            finding.get("reopen_count", 0), default=0
   262→        )
   263→        finding.setdefault("suppressed", False)
   264→        finding.setdefault("suppressed_at", None)
   265→        finding.setdefault("suppression_pattern", None)
   266→
   267→    for finding_id in to_remove:
   268→        findings.pop(finding_id, None)
   269→
   270→    for entry in state["scan_history"]:
   271→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   272→            continue
   273→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
   274→        if integrity is not None and not isinstance(integrity, dict):
   275→            entry["subjective_integrity"] = None
   276→
   277→    state["scan_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(state.get("scan_count", 0), default=0)
   278→    return None
   279→
   280→
   281→def validate_state_invariants(state: StateModel) -> None:
   282→    """Raise ValueError when core state invariants are violated."""
   283→    if not isinstance(state.get("findings"), dict):
   284→        raise ValueError("state.findings must be a dict")
   285→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   286→        raise ValueError("state.stats must be a dict")
   287→
   288→    findings = state["findings"]
   289→    for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
   290→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   291→            raise ValueError(f"finding {finding_id!r} must be a dict")
   292→        if finding.get("id") != finding_id:
   293→            raise ValueError(f"finding id mismatch for {finding_id!r}")
   294→        if finding.get("status") not in _ALLOWED_FINDING_STATUSES:
   295→            raise ValueError(
   296→                f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid status {finding.get('status')!r}"
   297→            )
   298→
   299→        tier = finding.get("tier")
   300→        if not isinstance(tier, int) or tier < 1 or tier > 4:
   301→            raise ValueError(f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid tier {tier!r}")
   302→
   303→        reopen_count = finding.get("reopen_count")
   304→        if not isinstance(reopen_count, int) or reopen_count < 0:
   305→            raise ValueError(
   306→                f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid reopen_count {reopen_count!r}"
   307→            )
   308→

   310→def json_default(obj: Any) -> Any:
   311→    """JSON serializer that handles known types and rejects unknowns."""
   312→    if isinstance(obj, set):
   313→        return sorted(obj)
   314→    if isinstance(obj, Path):
   315→        return str(obj).replace("\\", "/")
   316→    if hasattr(obj, "isoformat"):
   317→        return obj.isoformat()
   318→    raise TypeError(
   319→        f"Object of type {type(obj).__name__} is not JSON serializable: {obj!r}"
   320→    )
   321→
   322→
   323→def get_overall_score(state: StateModel) -> float | None:
   324→    """Canonical overall score (lenient, includes subjective dimensions)."""
   325→    return state.get("overall_score")
   326→
   327→
   328→def get_objective_score(state: StateModel) -> float | None:
   329→    """Canonical objective score (lenient, mechanical dimensions only)."""
   330→    return state.get("objective_score")
   331→
   332→
   333→def get_strict_score(state: StateModel) -> float | None:
   334→    """Canonical strict score (strict, includes subjective dimensions)."""
   335→    return state.get("strict_score")
   336→
   337→
   338→def get_verified_strict_score(state: StateModel) -> float | None:
   339→    """Strict score that only credits scan-verified fixes.
   340→
   341→    Returns None if no scan-verified score exists yet (fresh state or
   342→    no scan has run). Does not fall back to the unverified strict_score.
   343→    """
   344→    return state.get("verified_strict_score")
```

```
   132→
   133→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   134→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   135→
   136→    Handles migrations:
   137→    - v1 → v2: deferred list → skipped dict
   138→    - v3 → v4: epics dict → synthesis-clusters in clusters dict
   139→    """
   140→    defaults = empty_plan()
   141→    for key, value in defaults.items():
   142→        plan.setdefault(key, value)
   143→
   144→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   145→        plan["queue_order"] = []
   146→    if not isinstance(plan.get("deferred"), list):
   147→        plan["deferred"] = []
   148→    if not isinstance(plan.get("skipped"), dict):
   149→        plan["skipped"] = {}
   150→    if not isinstance(plan.get("overrides"), dict):
   151→        plan["overrides"] = {}
   152→    if not isinstance(plan.get("clusters"), dict):
   153→        plan["clusters"] = {}
   154→    if not isinstance(plan.get("superseded"), dict):
   155→        plan["superseded"] = {}
   156→    if not isinstance(plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta"), dict):
   157→        plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {}
   158→    meta = plan["epic_synthesis_meta"]
   159→    if not isinstance(meta.get("synthesis_stages"), dict):
   160→        meta["synthesis_stages"] = {}
   161→    if not isinstance(plan.get("deleted_clusters"), list):
   162→        plan["deleted_clusters"] = []
   163→
   164→    # Migrate deferred → skipped (v1 → v2)
   165→    deferred: list[str] = plan["deferred"]
   166→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   167→    if deferred:
   168→        now = utc_now()
   169→        for fid in list(deferred):
   170→            if fid not in skipped:
   171→                skipped[fid] = {
   172→                    "finding_id": fid,
   173→                    "kind": "temporary",
   174→                    "reason": None,
   175→                    "note": None,
   176→                    "attestation": None,
   177→                    "created_at": now,
   178→                    "review_after": None,
   179→                    "skipped_at_scan": 0,
   180→                }
   181→        deferred.clear()
   182→
   183→    # Normalize cluster fields
   184→    for cluster in plan["clusters"].values():
   185→        if isinstance(cluster, dict):
   186→            if not isinstance(cluster.get("finding_ids"), list):
   187→                cluster["finding_ids"] = []
   188→            cluster.setdefault("auto", False)
   189→            cluster.setdefault("cluster_key", "")
   190→            cluster.setdefault("action", None)
   191→            cluster.setdefault("user_modified", False)
   192→
   193→    # Migrate epics → clusters (v3 → v4)
   194→    old_epics = plan.pop("epics", None)
   195→    if old_epics and isinstance(old_epics, dict):
   196→        clusters = plan["clusters"]
   197→        now = utc_now()
   198→        for name, epic in old_epics.items():
   199→            if name not in clusters:
   200→                clusters[name] = {
   201→                    "name": name,
   202→                    "description": epic.get("thesis"),
   203→                    "finding_ids": list(epic.get("finding_ids", [])),
   204→                    "auto": True,
   205→                    "cluster_key": f"epic::{name}",
   206→                    "action": f"desloppify plan focus {name}",
   207→                    "user_modified": False,
   208→                    "created_at": epic.get("created_at", now),
   209→                    "updated_at": epic.get("updated_at", now),
   210→                    "thesis": epic.get("thesis"),
   211→                    "direction": epic.get("direction"),
   212→                    "root_cause": epic.get("root_cause"),
   213→                    "agent_safe": epic.get("agent_safe", False),
   214→                    "dependency_order": epic.get("dependency_order", 999),
   215→                    "action_steps": epic.get("action_steps", []),
   216→                    "status": epic.get("status", "pending"),
   217→                    "synthesis_version": epic.get("synthesis_version", 0),
   218→                    "supersedes": epic.get("supersedes", []),
   219→                    "dismissed": epic.get("dismissed", []),
   220→                    "source_clusters": epic.get("source_clusters", []),
   221→                }
   222→

   224→def synthesis_clusters(plan: PlanModel) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   225→    """Return clusters that were created by epic synthesis (have a thesis)."""
   226→    return {
   227→        name: cluster
   228→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   229→        if cluster.get("thesis")
   230→    }

   232→
   233→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   234→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   235→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   236→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   237→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   238→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   239→
   240→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   241→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   242→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   243→    if overlap:
   244→        raise ValueError(
   245→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   246→        )
   247→
   248→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   249→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   250→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   251→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   252→            raise ValueError(
   253→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
   254→            )
```

```
    28→def path_scoped_findings(
    29→    findings: dict[str, Finding],
    30→    scan_path: str | None,
    31→) -> dict[str, Finding]:
    32→    """Filter findings to those within the given scan path."""
    33→    return {
    34→        finding_id: finding
    35→        for finding_id, finding in findings.items()
    36→        if finding_in_scan_scope(str(finding.get("file", "")), scan_path)

    40→def finding_in_scan_scope(file_path: str, scan_path: str | None) -> bool:
    41→    """Return True when a file path belongs to the active scan scope."""
    42→    if not scan_path or scan_path == ".":
    43→        return True
    44→    prefix = scan_path.rstrip("/") + "/"
    45→    return (
    46→        file_path.startswith(prefix)
    47→        or file_path == scan_path
    48→        or file_path == "."
    49→    )

    51→
    52→def open_scope_breakdown(
    53→    findings: dict[str, Finding],
    54→    scan_path: str | None,
    55→    *,
    56→    detector: str | None = None,
    57→) -> dict[str, int]:
    58→    """Return open-finding counts split by in-scope vs out-of-scope carryover."""
    59→    in_scope = 0
    60→    out_of_scope = 0
    61→
    62→    for finding in findings.values():
    63→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
    64→            continue
    65→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
    66→            continue
    67→        if detector is not None and finding.get("detector") != detector:
    68→            continue
    69→        file_path = str(finding.get("file", ""))
    70→        if finding_in_scan_scope(file_path, scan_path):
    71→            in_scope += 1
    72→        else:
    73→            out_of_scope += 1
    74→
    75→    return {
    76→        "in_scope": in_scope,
    77→        "out_of_scope": out_of_scope,
    78→        "global": in_scope + out_of_scope,
    79→    }
    80→
    81→
    82→def is_ignored(finding_id: str, file: str, ignore_patterns: list[str]) -> bool:
    83→    """Check if a finding matches any ignore pattern (glob, ID prefix, or file path)."""
    84→    return matched_ignore_pattern(finding_id, file, ignore_patterns) is not None
    85→
    86→
    87→def matched_ignore_pattern(
    88→    finding_id: str, file: str, ignore_patterns: list[str]
    89→) -> str | None:
    90→    """Return the ignore pattern that matched, if any."""
    91→    for pattern in ignore_patterns:
    92→        if "*" in pattern:
    93→            target = finding_id if "::" in pattern else file
    94→            if fnmatch.fnmatch(target, pattern):
    95→                return pattern
    96→            continue
    97→
    98→        if "::" in pattern:
    99→            if finding_id.startswith(pattern):
   100→                return pattern
   101→            continue
   102→
   103→        if file == pattern or file == rel(pattern):
   104→            return pattern
   105→
   106→    return None
   107→
   108→
   109→def remove_ignored_findings(state: StateModel, pattern: str) -> int:
   110→    """Suppress findings matching an ignore pattern. Returns count affected."""
   111→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   112→    matched_ids = [
   113→        finding_id
   114→        for finding_id, finding in state["findings"].items()
   115→        if is_ignored(finding_id, finding["file"], [pattern])
   116→    ]
   117→    now = utc_now()
   118→    for finding_id in matched_ids:
   119→        finding = state["findings"][finding_id]
   120→        finding["suppressed"] = True
   121→        finding["suppressed_at"] = now
   122→        finding["suppression_pattern"] = pattern
   123→    # Deferred import to avoid circular dependency with engine._state.scoring
   124→    from desloppify.engine._state.scoring import _recompute_stats
   125→
   126→    _recompute_stats(state, scan_path=state.get("scan_path"))
   127→    validate_state_invariants(state)
   128→    return len(matched_ids)
   129→
   130→
   131→def add_ignore(state: StateModel, pattern: str) -> int:
   132→    """Add an ignore pattern and remove existing matching findings."""
   133→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   134→    config = state.setdefault("config", {})
   135→    ignores = config.setdefault("ignore", [])
   136→    if pattern not in ignores:
   137→        ignores.append(pattern)
   138→    return remove_ignored_findings(state, pattern)
   139→
   140→
   141→def make_finding(
   142→    detector: str,
   143→    file: str,
   144→    name: str,
   145→    *,
   146→    tier: int,
   147→    confidence: str,
   148→    summary: str,
   149→    detail: dict | None = None,
   150→) -> Finding:
   151→    """Create a normalized finding dict with a stable ID."""
   152→    rfile = rel(file)
   153→    finding_id = f"{detector}::{rfile}::{name}" if name else f"{detector}::{rfile}"
   154→    now = utc_now()
   155→    return {
   156→        "id": finding_id,
   157→        "detector": detector,
   158→        "file": rfile,
   159→        "tier": tier,
   160→        "confidence": confidence,
   161→        "summary": summary,
   162→        "detail": detail or {},
   163→        "status": "open",
   164→        "note": None,
   165→        "first_seen": now,
   166→        "last_seen": now,
   167→        "resolved_at": None,
   168→        "reopen_count": 0,
   169→    }
   170→
   171→
   172→def _matches_pattern(finding_id: str, finding: dict[str, str], pattern: str) -> bool:
   173→    """Check if a finding matches by ID, glob, prefix, detector, path, or hash suffix."""
   174→    if finding_id == pattern:
   175→        return True
   176→    if "*" in pattern and fnmatch.fnmatch(finding_id, pattern):
   177→        return True
   178→    if "::" in pattern and finding_id.startswith(pattern):
   179→        return True
   180→    if finding.get("detector") == pattern:
   181→        return True
   182→    file = finding.get("file", "")
   183→    if file == pattern or file.startswith(pattern.rstrip("/") + "/"):
   184→        return True
   185→    # 8-char hash suffix: match against the last :: segment of the finding ID
   186→    if len(pattern) >= 8 and "::" not in pattern and "*" not in pattern and "/" not in pattern:
   187→        last_seg = finding_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] if "::" in finding_id else ""
   188→        if last_seg and last_seg.startswith(pattern[:8]):
   189→            return True
   190→    return False
   191→
```

```
    16→@dataclass
    17→class ReconcileResult:
    18→    """Summary of changes made during reconciliation."""

    20→    superseded: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    26→def _find_candidates(
    27→    state: StateModel, detector: str, file: str
    28→) -> list[str]:
    29→    """Find open findings that could be remaps for a disappeared finding."""
    30→    candidates: list[str] = []
    31→    for fid, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items():
    32→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
    33→            continue
    34→        if finding.get("detector") == detector and finding.get("file") == file:
    35→            candidates.append(fid)
    36→    return candidates

    38→
    39→def _is_finding_alive(state: StateModel, finding_id: str) -> bool:
    40→    """Return True if the finding exists and is open."""
    41→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    42→    if finding is None:
    43→        return False
    44→    return finding.get("status") == "open"

    47→def _supersede_id(
    48→    plan: PlanModel,
    49→    state: StateModel,
    50→    finding_id: str,
    51→    now: str,
    52→) -> bool:
    53→    """Move a disappeared finding to superseded. Returns True if changed."""
    54→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    55→    detector = ""
    56→    file = ""
    57→    summary = ""
    58→    if finding:
    59→        detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    60→        file = finding.get("file", "")
    61→        summary = finding.get("summary", "")
    62→
    63→    candidates = _find_candidates(state, detector, file) if detector else []
    64→    # Don't include the original in candidates
    65→    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c != finding_id]
    66→
    67→    entry: SupersededEntry = {
    68→        "original_id": finding_id,
    69→        "original_detector": detector,
    70→        "original_file": file,
    71→        "original_summary": summary,
    72→        "status": "superseded",
    73→        "superseded_at": now,
    74→        "remapped_to": None,
    75→        "candidates": candidates[:5],
    76→    }

    78→    # Preserve any existing override note
    79→    override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(finding_id)
    80→    if override and override.get("note"):
    81→        entry["note"] = override["note"]
    82→
    83→    plan["superseded"][finding_id] = entry
    84→
    85→    # Remove from queue_order, skipped, cluster finding_ids
    86→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    87→    skipped: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    88→    if finding_id in order:
    89→        order.remove(finding_id)
    90→    skipped.pop(finding_id, None)
    91→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    92→        ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
    93→        if finding_id in ids:
    94→            ids.remove(finding_id)
    95→
    96→    return True
```
